name: total-blackout
description: The border forwards nothing at all: every packet from the client toward anywhere beyond the censor is silently dropped. The client still has a network (its gateway answers) — it is the outside world that is gone. No family can work; the point of the scenario is what the client CONCLUDES.
analogue: Iran's shutdowns executed in the data plane with BGP left announced: November 2019 (AS12880 'data plane went to zero'), the June 2025 stealth blackout, the January 2026 near-total blackout. Model: drop at the border. It does not model the domestic network that stays up behind it (there is no NIN host here except the gateway), nor BGP withdrawal.
